review: Macro counts are accounting only. Reviewed adaptations replace Bitcoin block fixtures and fixed header/hash/txid expectations; rejection, callback, reindex, UTXO/undo, handle-copy/move and chain-tree checks remain required.

adaptations.btck_block_header_tests: Replace PoW 80-byte fixtures with independently hashed 286-byte signed PoCX headers. Preserve empty/one-byte rejection and add rejection for every truncated header. Legacy Bits/Nonce accessors are specified as zero by current PoCX C API.
adaptations.btck_chainman_mainnet_tests: One actual mainnet real-proof block, independently verified quality and timing; preserve accept/duplicate/incompatible-regtest rejection, read-tip and both reindex modes.
adaptations.btck_chainman_regtest_tests: 206 actual real-proof blocks retain coinbase maturity, witness spend chain, final spent-coin height 205 and one-coin amount, interrupted resume, undo and UTXO/script checks. Transaction lookup still scans the unchanged chain in original order for every input, using a local per-height block cache to avoid repeated real-proof validation. Explicit per-block disk reads in the input/script loop and final output loop, and post-file-removal read rejection remain uncached. Added a required successful lookup read; no original assertion removed.
adaptations.btck_block: Same case body and original range/handle/malformed-input assertions, using native regtest block fixtures.
adaptations.btck_block_tree_entry_tests: Native first-three-block fixtures retain every tree-entry comparison and predecessor assertion; require the previously unchecked ProcessBlock call to succeed.
adaptations.btck_chainman_in_memory_tests: Native206-block fixtures retain filesystem/in-memory/context interruption assertions; require the previously unchecked ProcessBlock call to succeed.

fixtures: One mainnet and 206 regtest blocks; nonreserved key-1 account, nonzero seed, compression 1, nonce 1. Generated outputs stay in the build directory.
independent_verification: Rust scalar nonce/scoop/quality cross-checked with optimized Rust API; Python header hashes, generation signatures, rolling targets and time bending; output SHA256 frozen in provenance.json.
scope_limit: This restores the upstream kernel API cases; it does not establish all additional PoCX signer, scheduler or competing-chain acceptance criteria.

source_ownership.note: Case-logic reuse is distinct from source reuse. The single original test translation unit mixes generic and block/chain cases; the owned adaptation currently contains all16 cases.
